outcomeNote: An observation linking mishna and baraita.

segments.he: גְּמָ׳ תְּנֵינָא לְהָא דְּתָנוּ רַבָּנַן: שׁוֹטֶה וְקָטָן שֶׁנָּשְׂאוּ נָשִׁים, וּמֵתוּ נְשׁוֹתֵיהֶן — פְּטוּרוֹת מִן הַחֲלִיצָה וּמִן הַיִּיבּוּם.
segments.en: «GEMARA:» «We» already «learned that» the marriage of an imbecile is invalid, «as the Sages taught» in a baraita: With regard to «an imbecile and a minor boy who married women and died, their wives are exempt from ḥalitza and from levirate marriage.»

moves.summary: the gemara notes the mishna already taught the baraita's rule
moves.about: the mishna's ruling that an imbecile does not enable eating teruma already teaches that his marriage is not a marriage
